summary: This infobox-style note gives the basic profile of the University of Miami, a private institution established in 1925 in Coral Gables, Florida. It lists its motto, affiliations, leadership, finances, enrollment and staffing, campus size, colors, and athletics details including its Hurricanes nickname and NCAA Division I membership in the ACC.
one_line: Profile of the University of Miami, a private Coral Gables, Florida university founded in 1925, covering its leadership, enrollment, finances and athletics.
key_facts: The University of Miami's Latin name is Universitas Miamiensis.
The University of Miami's motto is "Magna est veritas", which the note translates as "Great is the truth".
The University of Miami was established in 1925 and is a private institution.
The University of Miami is located in Coral Gables, Florida, U.S., with a suburban campus.
The University of Miami's campus totals 453 acres (1.83 km).
The University of Miami had an endowment of $949 million in 2017.
The University of Miami had a budget of $3.3 billion in 2016.
Richard D. Fain is the Chairman of the University of Miami.
Julio Frenk is the President of the University of Miami.
Jeffrey Duerk is the Provost of the University of Miami.
The University of Miami had 16,801 students, including 10,849 undergraduates and 5,952 postgraduates.
The University of Miami had 3,045 academic staff and 10,985 administrative staff.
The University of Miami's colors are orange, green and white.
The University of Miami's nickname is the Hurricanes and its mascot is Sebastian the Ibis.
The University of Miami competes in NCAA Division I in the ACC and is affiliated with NAICU, SURA and ORAU.
